example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা দাগি চোর, আবার ধরা পড়লে কঠোর শাস্তি পাবে।
পুলিশ বলল, এই দাগি আসামীকে ছাড়া যাবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a career criminal and will face severe punishment if caught again.
The police said this convicted offender cannot be released.
history: The term originates from the colonial-era practice in Bengal where convicts were branded with hot irons on their foreheads or bodies to mark them as criminals, a punishment system influenced by British and earlier Mughal administrations.
note: This idiom reflects historical penal practices and is still used metaphorically to denote repeat offenders.
